blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Toledo-Xignex Trojans split another set of back-to-back matches in the Philippine Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup over the weekend, defeating the Camarines Soaring Eagles before absorbing a loss to the Manila AQ Prime Assets. Toledo opened its weekend campaign with a 13.5-7.5 victory over Camarines, overcoming a 5.5-1.5 deficit in the blitz round with an 8-6 win in the rapid round. Grandmaster Rogelio Barcenilla Jr. drew with Giovanni Mejia in the blitz round before scoring a win in their rapid encounter on Board 1.
